Launch the first version fast, without building yourself into a corner

Early on, the job is to learn whether people want what you are making. We help you get a credible landing page or first application in front of them, built so it can grow.

Plan your MVPGet a quote

Match the build to your stage

Spending too much too early is the most common startup technology mistake. Start with what tests your idea.

  1. Test the idea

    A focused landing page that explains the offer and collects interest.

  2. Build the MVP

    The smallest web application that delivers the core value to early users.

  3. Grow carefully

    Add features based on real usage, with maintenance and monitoring in place.

How we help founders

Landing pages

A clear pitch, one call to action, and a sign-up form that reaches you.

MVP websites

A small, credible website to show investors, partners, and first customers.

Custom applications

A first version of your product with sign-in, data, and the core workflow.

Technology planning

Advice on stack, hosting, and what to build versus buy, in plain language.
